registry.title: Foreign PEP Registry

registry.partnerSubtitle: Profiles disclosed to your financial intelligence unit.

newPerson.title: New check
newPerson.subtitle: The system searches open sources via SearXNG, screens sanctions lists and builds a preliminary profile. This takes a few minutes.
newPerson.fullNameHint: As in documents, Cyrillic or Latin: «Ivanov Petr Sergeevich».
newPerson.latinHint: Optional: transliteration is used if empty.
newPerson.birthDateHint: Helps tell namesakes apart and match sanctions lists.
newPerson.contextHint: Company, position or country — added to search queries.
newPerson.fullNameRequired: Enter a full name (at least 3 characters)
newPerson.notice: The request and results are stored in the registry; the action is recorded in the audit log.

requestDialog.infoDescription: Outgoing request to a foreign FIU. The exchange status is shown in the “Sources and verification” card.
requestDialog.partnerInfoDescription: Request to the financial intelligence unit that disclosed this profile.
requestDialog.discloseTitle: Send the profile to a partner FIU
requestDialog.discloseDescription: The partner gets access to the current version of the profile. The disclosure is recorded in the request log and cannot be revoked.
requestDialog.noPartners: There are no active partners in the directory — contact an administrator.
requestDialog.purposeHint: For example: verifying the source of funds in a transaction.
requestDialog.done: The entry was added to the request log.

review.title: Analyst decision
review.description: The automatic result is kept; the decision is applied on top of it and recalculates the overall score.
review.commentRequired: A justification is required (at least 3 characters)
review.conclusionHint: Leave empty to use the automatic conclusion.

sanctions.title: Sanctions lists
sanctions.subtitle: Official UN, OFAC (US), EU and UK lists are loaded daily; screening accounts for transliteration and word order.
sanctions.name: Name
sanctions.noResults: No matches in the loaded lists.
sanctions.hint: A match is only a reason to check: identity is confirmed by date of birth, citizenship and documents.

methodology.title: Assessment methodology
methodology.subtitle: How the system determines PEP status and calculates risk. The methodology is versioned: the version is stored in every profile.
methodology.noDataPoints: No data — {points} points: missing information is not treated as low risk.
methodology.domesticList: Domestic PEPs of the Republic of Kazakhstan
methodology.callForAction: Call for countermeasures / enhanced due diligence
methodology.formula: Score = Σ(weight × level points) ÷ Σ(weight); minimum levels are then applied.
